##Tomorrow##

Clear spells, with a slight frost in places around dawn and a small risk of icy patches. Minimum temperature 0°C on higher ground and in the central valley. Sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving around midnight, falling as snow on hills. Fresh northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later in evening. Top temperature of 8°C.

##Visibility##

##Comments##

##Tuesday, 17 November 2026##

Rain continuing through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground before temperatures rise. Minimum temperature 1°C . The persistent band of rain clears in the morning, though intermittent spells of rain continue for much of the day. Strong to gale force east winds gradually easing. Top temperature 10°C.
